name: 清新雅致日常淡香水款
description: 清新淡香喷雾香水，透明玻璃瓶身，日常通勤优雅不浓烈

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, warm apricot #F2C6A5 panels for benefit and CTA shots, soft grey marble #EDE8E4 for flat-lay and detail shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and gentle fill, soft contact shadows, subtle warm rim, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: polished grey-white marble slab #EDE8E4 and matte apricot podium #F2C6A5
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons in rose tone #C4707B only
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft feminine fragrance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, warm apricot #F2C6A5, rose-dusty accent #C4707B and grey-white marble #EDE8E4; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line rose icons; clean high-end fragrance photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的正面瓶身
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bottle standing upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle stands upright, photographed straight-on at eye-level, full product visible with crisp silhouette. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the bottle. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. 8K, commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background tint, no cut-off edges, no floating bottle without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒传达清新淡香的日常调性，承接点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, product centered-right on a round podium
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, gentle warm rim from the right, soft contact shadow
shots.background: warm apricot gradient panel #F2C6A5 with soft floating bubble bokeh
shots.props: a low round podium disc and a few small matte spheres in muted tones, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the upper-left 35% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle shown at a slight 3/4 hero angle on a low round podium, positioned center-right and occupying 50-60% of the frame. Warm apricot gradient background #F2C6A5 with soft floating bubble bokeh, soft front-left key light and gentle warm rim, soft contact shadow. Small matte spheres as quiet props. Generous negative space on the upper-left 35% reserved for 「{selling_point_1}」. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented fragrance-note pyramid or wear-time claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product, no brand wordmark.

shots.intent: 放大浓烈熏人、场合尴尬的用香痛点，引出淡香方案
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, identical straight-on eye-level on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel heavy and flat; right panel bright and airy with soft front fill
shots.props: abstract swirling dark mist on the left panel only
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}, two matched panels with identical straight-on eye-level framing. Left panel: abstract heavy dark mist swirling in a stuffy room, evoking an overpowering cloying scent, no people. Right panel: {product} with a light airy wisp of soft mist in clean bright air. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Grey-white marble background #EDE8E4 on both panels; left side lit flat and heavy, right side bright and airy with soft front fill. The product occupies 40-50% of the right panel. Negative: no real model face, no fabricated statistics, no invented scent or duration claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered scene.

shots.intent: 代入清晨梳妆喷香的生活场景，唤起日常使用欲
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level in-context view over a dressing-table corner
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle haze, soft contact shadow
shots.background: matte warm-beige dressing table #E7D9C9 with softly blurred room depth
shots.props: a folded linen cloth and one pale tulip stem, not covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} resting on a matte warm-beige dressing-table corner #E7D9C9 in soft morning light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level in-context view with gentle room depth behind. Soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, faint haze, soft contact shadow. Props: a folded linen cloth and one pale tulip stem beside, never covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame. Framing crops at the shoulders if any person is implied, showing no face at all. Negative: no visible face or recognizable person, no hands covering the product, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered background, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 用细腻喷雾与瓶口工艺特写证明质感与使用体验
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the spray nozzle and fine mist, side profile view, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: skimming light from the right revealing fine mist droplets and metal finish
shots.whitespace: minimal, the mist detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the spray nozzle releasing a fine even mist, side profile view. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground droplets sharp. Skimming light from the right revealing the fine mist texture and the brushed metal collar finish. Neutral matte board background #EFE9E1. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Negative: no blurry subject, no deformed nozzle geometry, no invented ingredient claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands, no duplicated product elements.

shots.intent: 俯拍平铺展示瓶身玻璃质感与花材氛围，消除材质疑虑
shots.camera: flat lay, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even diffused high-key flat lighting, soft minimal shadow
shots.props: two pale pink tulip blooms placed off to one side, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: clear margin strip along one edge for a short label 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce material flat lay of {product}, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, bottle lying elegantly on a grey-white marble slab #EDE8E4. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even diffused high-key flat lighting with soft minimal shadow. Two pale pink tulip blooms placed off to one side, never covering the product. The product occupies 45-50% of the frame, with a clear margin strip along one edge reserved for 「{callout_1}」. Negative: no tiny unreadable text, no invented material or craftsmanship data, no watermark, no fake logo, no props overlapping the label, no duplicated flower patterns in the background.

shots.intent: 并列展示不同规格选择，稳定同角度方便比选
shots.camera: two bottles side by side, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, identical framing across both
shots.lighting: even soft studio light, matched contact shadows under both bottles
shots.whitespace: narrow even gutter between bottles, no extra margin copy space
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant display of {product} in two size options side by side, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down with identical framing and lighting across both bottles. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft studio light with matched contact shadows under each bottle. Clean white-to-apricot soft panel background #F6DCC4. The pair occupies 60-70% of the frame overall. Negative: no lighting drift between the two bottles, no size distortion, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no invented spec numbers, no price tags.

shots.intent: 收口促单，用氛围光与按钮位引导下单
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level product shot centered low, copy field above
shots.lighting: punchier soft studio light with a warm glow halo behind the bottle, soft contact shadow
shots.background: warm apricot #F2C6A5 with a subtle rose #C4707B corner glow
shots.props: one empty rounded CTA button shape below the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the upper 40% for headline and button
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle centered low, photographed straight-on at eye-level, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Warm apricot background #F2C6A5 with a subtle rose #C4707B corner glow, punchier soft studio light with a warm halo behind the bottle and a soft contact shadow. One empty rounded CTA button shape below the product, with an empty headline field 「{callout_2}」 in the upper negative space of 40%. Negative: no invented discounts or countdowns, no real offer numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body text, no QR code, no membership badge.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 主视觉为透明方形玻璃瓶+银色喷头、蜜杏渐变背景+竖条与圆珠道具+圆台底座，文案为「清香扑鼻/全新日用香水/舒适透气/芳香美味」；P2 烦恼引导页+三张 01/02/03 编号卡片（粉圆瓶+大理石+郁金香平铺图）；P3 瓶身配三个细线图标卖点位与圆形粉瓶横幅；P4 四张空白渐变卡片带耐性标签位（疑为挪用其它品类的套版文案）；P5 三张空白白卡（十年周期/精工细选/优选好原料）；P6-7 产品细节展示，玫瑰豆沙色块+大理石郁金香平铺，文案含轴承钢/胶条/80% 等明显错置内容；P8 产品参数表（规格 99999G、保质期 18 个月、玻璃材质、阴凉处）+双瓶并列+红色会员角标与二维码。品类判定依据：全篇画面均为喷雾香水玻璃瓶实物图且标题明确写「日用香水」，参数区材质为玻璃——按图判为美妆彩妆/香氛，源夹名「洗护」不采信。已剥离内容：原品牌与系列字样、英文水印贴片、会员徽标与二维码、原文案原句；香气描述（香柠檬/绿叶/常春藤）属具体香调主张，未作为事实写入，一律以 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位；源页多处文案明显为其它品类套版错置（衣物领口吸附、轴承钢、胶条包边、耐酸碱耐雨季），且参数表规格 99999G 为占位乱数——上述自相矛盾或错置数值均两种说法都未写入；规格与保质期数值以 {callout_n} 或留空 proof 位替代；未出现模特，无需处理面容。
